Maria (CSM): Heads up — Orbis Health onboarding spike: embeddings + reranking steps spiked tokens yesterday, now flagged as budget risk for renewal. Need a quick forecast + alert.
Alex (FinOps): On it. I'll run a 30d burn projection and share a per-route breakdown. Any sample time window? 48h peak + steady 7d average?
Maria (CSM): Yes, 48h peak + 7d avg. Also capture dev vs prod traffic — they'd like to move dev to lower tier during onboarding.
Jay (Onboarding): I'll schedule an enablement session with their eng leads for Tue. Can someone drop recommended config: batching + prefills + quantization suggestions? @Sam please jump in.
Sam (Solutions): Dropping a quick config snippet we recommended last time:
```json
{"batch_size":32, "cache_prefix":true, "quant_profile":"q8_0", "route":"embed-heavy"}
```
Will also collect their sample prompts and any long-context flows.
Emma (Product): We should create a temporary budget alert: trigger at 60% of 30d forecast, email ops + CSM, and tag renewal-risk. Also add a short note in the QBR prep doc about onboarding-driven anomalies.
Alex (FinOps): Created alert: `alert_id=AL-7821` -> threshold=0.6*forecast, channels=#customer-success + email maria@redwood.com. Running projection now, will post numbers in ~20m.
CostBot: Alert AL-7821 created for account orbis-health. Watchlist: token_burn_daily rising 3.4x. :warning:
Maria (CSM): Thanks — I'll prep a 1-pager for the renewal owner and include the enablement invite. Sam, ping me when you have prompts and I'll add them to the QBR prompt set.
Alex (FinOps): Projection posted: 30d forecast = 1.25M tokens (with current onboarding cadence). 60% threshold = 750k tokens. I'll attach per-route breakdown in the thread soon.
Sam (Solutions): Shared sample prompts + recommended routes in the doc. Also flagged two long-running rerank flows that can be batched differently to save ~18% token cost.
Maria (CSM): Solid. Plan: (1) Enablement Tue, (2) temp alert AL-7821 live, (3) implement batching/quant suggestions during onboarding ramp. I'll update renewal owner after enablement. :thumbsup:
